params.model_s_covers: features on the host to token ids on the host: the features copied to the device, the encoder step and every decoder step, each waited for
params.encoder_ms_covers: the engine's encoder step, waited for: features copied to the device and rounded to FP16, convolutions, encoder layers and the cross-attention keys and values of every decoder layer
params.first_token_ms_covers: features on the host to the first generated token on the host, timed inside the engine's transcribe call
